snp3.10:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
snp3.10:1.3: atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho kokāliko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
snp3.10:1.4: pāpicchā bhante sārīputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṅgatāti.
snp3.10:2.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
snp3.10:2.2: mā hevaṃ kokālika mā hevaṃ kokālika
snp3.10:3.1: dutiyampi kho kokāliko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca kiñcāpi me bhante bhagavā saddhāyiko paccayiko atha kho pāpicchā va sāriputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṅgatāti. dutiyampi kho bhagavā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca mā hevaṃ kokālika mā hevaṃ kokālika pasādehi kokālika sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ pesalā sāriputtamoggallānāti.
snp3.10:3.2: tatiyampi kho kokāliko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
snp3.10:3.3: kiñcāpi me bhante bhagavā saddhāyiko paccayiko atha kho pāpicchā va sāriputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṅgatāti.
snp3.10:3.4: tatiyampi kho bhagavā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
snp3.10:3.5: mā hevaṃ kokālika mā hevaṃ kokālika
snp3.10:4.1: atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
snp3.10:4.2: acirapakkantasseva kokālikassa bhikkhuno sāsapamattāhi piḷakāhi sabbo kāyo phuṭṭho ahosi.
snp3.10:4.3: sāsapamattiyo hutvā muggamattiyo ahesuṃ. muggamattiyo hutvā kaḷāyamattiyo ahesuṃ. kaḷāyamattiyo hutvā koḷaṭṭhimattiyo ahesuṃ. koḷaṭṭhimattiyo hutvā kolamattiyo ahesuṃ. kolamattiyo hutvā āmalakamattiyo ahesuṃ. āmalakamattiyo hutvā veḷuvasalāṭukamattiyo ahesuṃ. veluvasalāṭukamattiyo hutvā villamattiyo ahesuṃ. villamattiyo hutvā pabhijjiṃsu. pubbañca lohitañca pagghariṃsu.
snp3.10:4.4: atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu tenevābādhena kālamakāsi.
snp3.10:4.5: kālakato ca kokāliko bhikkhu padumanirayaṃ upapajjati sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghā tetvā.
snp3.10:5.1: atha kho brahmā sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho brahmā sahampati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
snp3.10:5.3: kālakato ca bhante kokāliko bhikkhu padumanirayaṃ upapanno sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvāti.
snp3.10:6.1: atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi
snp3.10:6.2: imaṃ bhikkhave rattiṃ brahmā sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā …pe…
snp3.10:6.3: idamavoca bhikkhave brahmā sahampati idaṃ vatvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyīti.
snp3.10:7.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
snp3.10:7.2: kīvadīghaṃ nu kho bhante padumaniraye āyuppamāṇanti.
snp3.10:7.4: taṃ na sukaraṃ saṅkhātuṃ ettakāni vassāni iti vā ettakāni vassasatāni iti vā ettakāni vassasahassāni iti vā ettakāni vassasatasahassāni iti vāti.
snp3.10:8.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsatikhāriko kosalako tilavāho tato puriso vassasatassa vassasahassassa vassasatasahassassa accayena ekamekaṃ tilaṃ uddhareyya
snp3.10:8.2: khippataraṃ kho so bhikkhu vīsatikhāriko kosalako tilavāho iminā upakkamena pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya na tveva eko abbudo nirayo
snp3.10:8.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati abbudā nirayā evameko nirabbudo nirayo
snp3.10:8.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati nirabbudā nirayā evameko ababo nirayo
snp3.10:8.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati ababā nirayā evameko ahaho nirayo seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati ahahā nirayā evameko aṭaṭo nirayo
snp3.10:8.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati aṭaṭā nirayā evameko
snp3.10:8.8: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati kumudā nirayā evameko sogandhiko nirayo
snp3.10:8.9: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati sogandhikā nirayā evameko uppalako nirayo
snp3.10:8.10: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati uppalakā nirayā evameko puṇḍarīko nirayo
snp3.10:8.11: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati puṇḍarīkā nirayā evameko padumo nirayo
snp3.10:8.12: padumaṃ kho pana bhikkhu nirayaṃ kokāliko bhikkhu upapanno sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvāti
snp3.10:8.14: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā
snp3.10:13.2: yo vāpi katvā na karomīti cāha
snp3.10:28.4: kiccakaro siyā naro na ca majje.
